description: File facts and pixel statistics for any image.

faqs.a: No. It reads file facts (name, size, type, dimensions) and computes pixel statistics (average color, luminance histogram) — it does not parse EXIF, IPTC or XMP metadata.
faqs.q: Does this show EXIF camera data?

faqs.a: The average is computed from every pixel of a downscaled copy of your image, so it genuinely represents the whole picture.
faqs.q: How is the average color calculated?

faqs.a: Yes — everything is processed locally in your browser. The file never leaves your device.

howto: Drop an image onto the dropzone or click to browse.
Wait a moment while the pixels are analyzed.
Read the file facts, dimensions and average color.
Study the 16-bin luminance histogram for the brightness spread.
title: Image Metadata Viewer
